yearMeaning: 1946 is the year of the independence declaration, not independently verified as the legal enactment year of the recurring public holiday.
authority: Prime Ministry of Jordan, original Declaration of Independence; Jordan News Agency Petra, archival Official Gazette report
dateReason: The fifth Legislative Council unanimously declared full independence and a hereditary representative monarchy on 25 May 1946.

sourceEvidence.claim: The Prime Ministry publishes the 25 May 1946 independence declaration and the Legislative Council's unanimous decision.
Petra describes issue 861 of the Official Gazette and the 25 May 1946 constitutional decision.

narratives.en: On 25 May 1946, Transjordan's Legislative Council unanimously proclaimed the country fully independent and endorsed Abdullah ibn al-Hussein as constitutional king. The decision followed a 15 May cabinet memorandum and municipal resolutions calling for sovereignty. Independence Day remembers that parliamentary act and the transition from emirate to Hashemite monarchy; the date of the declaration should not be confused with every later step in the treaty process.
narratives.it: Il 25 maggio 1946 il Consiglio legislativo della Transgiordania proclamò all'unanimità la piena indipendenza e riconobbe Abdullah ibn al-Hussein come re costituzionale. La decisione seguì un memorandum del governo del 15 maggio e le deliberazioni dei consigli municipali a favore della sovranità. La festa ricorda quell'atto parlamentare e il passaggio dall'emirato alla monarchia hashemita, senza confondere la proclamazione con le successive formalità dei trattati.
narratives.es: El 25 de mayo de 1946, el Consejo Legislativo de Transjordania proclamó por unanimidad la plena independencia y reconoció a Abdalá ibn al-Hussein como rey constitucional. La decisión siguió a un memorando del gabinete del 15 de mayo y a resoluciones municipales favorables a la soberanía. La fiesta recuerda aquel acto parlamentario y el paso del emirato a la monarquía hachemí, sin confundir la proclamación con los trámites posteriores de los tratados.
narratives.fr: Le 25 mai 1946, le Conseil législatif de Transjordanie proclama à l'unanimité l'indépendance complète du pays et reconnut Abdallah ibn al-Hussein comme roi constitutionnel. Cette décision faisait suite à un mémorandum gouvernemental du 15 mai et à des résolutions municipales favorables à la souveraineté. La fête rappelle cet acte parlementaire et le passage de l'émirat à la monarchie hachémite, sans confondre proclamation et formalités ultérieures des traités.
narratives.de: Am 25. Mai 1946 erklärte der Legislativrat Transjordaniens einstimmig die volle Unabhängigkeit und bestätigte Abdullah ibn al-Hussein als konstitutionellen König. Vorausgegangen waren ein Kabinettsmemorandum vom 15. Mai und Beschlüsse von Gemeinderäten zugunsten der Souveränität. Der Feiertag erinnert an diesen Parlamentsbeschluss und den Übergang vom Emirat zur haschemitischen Monarchie; die Erklärung ist nicht mit sämtlichen späteren Vertragsschritten gleichzusetzen.
narratives.pt: Em 25 de maio de 1946, o Conselho Legislativo da Transjordânia proclamou por unanimidade a independência plena e reconheceu Abdullah ibn al-Hussein como rei constitucional. A decisão seguiu um memorando do governo de 15 de maio e resoluções municipais em defesa da soberania. A data celebra esse ato parlamentar e a passagem do emirado à monarquia hachemita, sem confundir a proclamação com as formalidades posteriores dos tratados.
